rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a visual symbol identifying a company or organization.

example.english: You can tell which company it is just by looking at this logo.
example.traditional: 呢個標誌一睇就知係邊間公司嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 biu1 zi3 jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 hai6 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the logo is a company's trademark or brand mark.

example.english: This logo is already registered, so you can't use it freely.
example.traditional: 呢個商標已經註冊咗，唔可以亂用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng1 biu1 ji5 ging1 zyu3 caak3 zo2 m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 jung6
